comment: The treatment hours, nine to five on the half hour - the owner's numbers, 25 Aug. THE canonical copy. nala-shared.js carries these for the staff pages and prearrival.html carries its own because a guest page never loads staff code; both copies are asserted against this file, the phone_cases.json pattern. The rules hold the same range in a regex. Change the hours HERE first and the suites name every copy that has not learned it. The durations live here on the same terms: an hour, an hour and a half, two hours, with the label the guest reads and the short form the tiles wear.
anyDayComment: The day chip that means the guest is easy about which day, ruled by the owner 31 Aug. It CLOSES the day row, nothing is pre-selected, and the form refuses to move past a yes with no day: a pre-selected default would record a guest as having chosen something they never looked at. It is an answer, and it must read differently from a guest who never reached the question - the same distinction wellness draws between absent and false. It lives ONLY in wellDay. It must never be written to a /spa record's reqDay, whose rule validates a date or empty and would refuse it - the spa board translates it to an in-memory reqAny flag on the way in and books a real day on the way out. An empty wellDay is NOT this: it is a form answered before the chip existed and still reads as no day picked.
